name: Integration Guide
description: A guide for a team integrating with this service: contract, limits, auth, failure modes.
prompt_template:
You are writing a integration guide for the service described by this spec.

{grounding_context}

Use ONLY the assertions above. Every claim must trace to one. If a required fact is absent, write '[not specified in spec]' rather than inventing it. Reproduce any assertion marked Tier 1 verbatim.

Produce these sections: overview, interface_contract, limits_and_quotas, authentication, failure_modes.
